sampling.step_rule: the most frequent positive difference between consecutive timestamps
sampling.note: the autocorrelation and stationarity tests below read the rows as EQUALLY spaced; where regular_fraction is below 1.0 that reading is an approximation the file does not support

analysis_segment.rule: the longest run of 'Global_active_power' with no missing cell; the tests below read only these rows

stationarity.rows_rule: the first 20000 rows of the analysis segment at most; the head, never the end a holdout will be cut from

heuristic.rule: lag-1 autocorrelation >= 0.95 AND the mean autocorrelation over those lags >= 0.5 -> NON_STATIONARY
heuristic.caveat: this is a rule over two numbers, not a hypothesis test, and carries no p-value

adf.rule: p <= 0.05 rejects the unit root -> STATIONARY

kpss.null_hypothesis: the series is stationary around a constant

seasonality.computed_on_reason: the stationarity verdict is STATIONARY, so the levels carry the periodicity
seasonality.estimator: biased autocorrelation by FFT, normalised at lag 0
seasonality.band_rule: 1.96 / sqrt(rows_used), the white-noise band of the estimator
seasonality.peak_rule: the highest local maxima outside the band, one per bump: a peak within 10% of the lag of a higher one is the same bump of the estimator and not a second period
seasonality.decay_rule: the first lag whose autocorrelation falls inside the band

why.windows: the autocorrelation of the levels falls inside the +-0.011206 band at lag 197 -> window 197
why.lags: lag 1 always, and the decay lag 197 as the last lag still outside the band
why.transform: level: the stationarity verdict is STATIONARY (adf+kpss agree)
why.features: none: no periodic peak motivates a calendar feature in this candidate

not_decided.calendar.clock: a file of timestamps cannot say whether they are a publication clock or a receipt clock; 'receipt' is written so the spec validates and a person must confirm it (--clock)
not_decided.holdout: the cut is a decision about what must stay unseen, which no test on the data can make; {"fraction": 0.2} is a convention, not a measurement
not_decided.sampling.timezone: the timestamps carry no offset, so 'UTC' is what --timezone declared, not what was read
not_decided.exogenous: the other numeric columns are offered as names only; whether each is available at prediction time is not a property of this file
